sources.scope: SHA-256 sample lists from 12 explicitly selected Android-campaign folders; no full ESET antivirus engine or database
Echap samples with Android package and certificate metadata, explicitly classified as stalkerware by ioc.yaml
sources.interpretation: Exact match to a published surveillance-app sample, not proof of non-consensual monitoring. The user's post-reset preference can make a matching ordinary app a removal candidate after live preflight; Android user approval remains mandatory.

sources.scope: Echap samples with Android package and certificate metadata, explicitly classified as watchware by watchware.yaml
sources.interpretation: Monitoring or parental-control software may be intentional and legitimate. A post-reset removal preference does not upgrade this category to confirmed malware; live preflight and Android user approval remain mandatory.

removalPolicy.userExpectation: The user runs RefurbCheck immediately after factory reset and expects no intentionally installed monitoring or management app.
removalPolicy.automaticSteps: Scan installed APKs, select eligible reference matches, revalidate the live target, then request Android's uninstall confirmation.
requirements: Use only the current in-memory scan inventory; imported reports and these provenance records cannot drive removal.
Exclude system apps, updated system apps and RefurbCheck itself.
Require complete, stable exact file evidence bound to the matched APK's SHA-256; a monitoring reference retains its monitoring classification.
Immediately before confirmation, reload the pinned shipping catalog and reproduce the exact source, signature, digest, size and whole-APK or entry identity.
Recheck the target APK on one file descriptor, its file stamps and hashes, plus the package version, update time and full base/split path set.
Block on cancellation, resource limits, incomplete archive scanning, database errors, changed evidence, active target administrator privileges or unreadable administrator state.
Android's confirmation and the user's approval are required for deletion; requesting the dialog is not a completed-removal claim.
removalPolicy.monitoringInterpretation: This is the user's installation preference after reset, not evidence that monitoring occurred without consent or that every monitoring tool is malicious.

transformations: Parsed exact SHA-256 sample indicators only
Excluded Echap samples lacking Android package/certificate metadata
Sorted and deduplicated exact TSV records
limitations: Hash matches detect unchanged known files only
No-match does not establish absence of malware
No malware binaries downloaded or analysed
No certificate-only or package-name-only malware rules
Source publication date does not mean every sample is newly discovered
Input source commits are pinned but not asserted to be publisher-signed
